snippet.title: Metroid Dread - GBC Demake Demo
snippet.description:
Game released by: Elvies
https://elvies.itch.io/

This is a fan demake of the first 3-5 minutes of the game up to the first E.M.M.I. encounter. The author is not continuing this game for legality reasons, so there may be bugs that break the game.

...................................................
*Note: The music is not included in the actual demo.
Background Music:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5pOdGBBfppE
